name: Yakir

battleDialogue.onEncounter: Ah, right on time.|Take a seat - it's time to learn C#!.|These lessons will unlock your true potential.
onAttack: That's a runtime error waiting to happen.
You didn't even check for null first.
This is going straight into your final grade.
onAct: C# is such an excellent language to learn|Surely you will be able to find a job once you learn it!| But before we do...
Seems like this was pretty easy for you! Onto the next lesson!.
The third lesson is really hard! Good luck!
I have seen some students fail on this lesson!|Are you also going to fail?|I believe you won't!
Wow, you are really good at this!
battleDialogue.onDefeat: How could you have done this?|We were having so much fun together...|I just wanted you to learn how to code.....|........|I guess I was wrong....
battleDialogue.onSpared: It seems you have learned everything you need to be a successful dev|Don't forget to come to C# Advanced next semester!.

moves.name: Conditionals
moves.description: The lesson moves on to if statements.

moves.name: Loops
moves.description: The lesson moves on to repetition.

moves.name: The Program
moves.description: Everything he taught, running at once.

moves.name: One Pixel
moves.description: After all these years, he finally draws it.

descriptionByHp.text: Yakir - HP 51, ATK 4. Teaches C# and Unity at Tiltan.|Why does he have 51 HP? It doesn't matter.

actOptions.name: Debug
actOptions.description: You ask Yakir for help debugging your Final Project's code.
extraMessages: Yakir then solves the issue with extreme precision and accuracy.|You can't be anything less than shocked and impressed

actOptions.name: Compliment
actOptions.description: You tell Yakir his lectures are actually useful.

actOptions.name: Photo
actOptions.description: There's a photo taped inside his laptop lid.
extraMessages: A kid in a blue jumpsuit and gloves, mid-pose.|It's him.
actOptions.speech: That was ONE Purim. ONE.|...You want to see it? Fine.|YOU ASKED FOR THIS.

spareSuccessText: Yakir nods once and lets you pass.

spareTextByPercent.text: Yakir isn't finished with the lesson yet.
Yakir seems less interested in fighting.
Yakir is packing up his laptop...

turnNarrationByHp.text: * Yakir is currently opening his laptop.
* Yakir opens a new project file.

turnNarrationBySpare.text: * Yakir is ready to call it a semester.
